tool_input.command:
cd ~/source/personal/vloop/internal/cli && mkdir -p testdata/skillcheck && cd testdata/skillcheck && 
mk(){ p=$1; mkdir -p $p/.claude-plugin $p/skills/work $p/evals/case-a/graders
printf '{"name":"vloop","version":"0.0.0-dev"}\n' >$p/.claude-plugin/plugin.json
cat >$p/skills/work/SKILL.md <<'EOF'
---
name: work
description: Do exactly one task of the plan and report on it.
---
# Work

Invoked as `/vloop:work T1`; this is `vloop` at work.
Read the task with `vloop task show <id> --json`, then `vloop task show T1 --json`.
Write `.vloop/tmp/proposal.json`, read `.vloop/state/state.json` and `.vloop/config.toml`, and check it with `vloop schema validate proposal/v1 .vloop/tmp/proposal.json`.

```json
{"schema": "proposal/v1", "task": "T1", "outcome": "done", "summary": "s", "files": [], "verified": "v", "notes": ""}
```

```json
{"note": "a block with no schema field is not checked"}
```
EOF
printf '%s\n' '---' 'max_turns: 5' 'allowed_tools: [Read, Bash]' '---' '/vloop:work T1' >$p/evals/case-a/prompt.md
printf '%s\n' '---' 'type: llm' 'weight: 1' '---' 'Passes when the proposal validates.' >$p/evals/case-a/graders/valid.md; }
cp_(){ rm -rf $1; cp -R good $1; }
ap(){ f=$1; shift; mkdir -p $(dirname $f); printf '%s\n' "$@" >>$f; }
mk good
cp_ bad-command; ap bad-command/skills/work/SKILL.md 'Then run `vloop task frobnicate T1`.'
cp_ bad-flag; ap bad-flag/skills/work/SKILL.md 'Then run `vloop task show T1 --frobnicate`.'
cp_ bad-schema-example; ap bad-schema-example/skills/work/SKILL.md '```json' '{"schema": "proposal/v1", "task": "T1", "outcome": "done", "summary": "s", "files": [], "notes": ""}' '```'
cp_ bad-schema-name; ap bad-schema-name/skills/work/SKILL.md 'Check it with `vloop schema validate frobnicate/v1 x.json`.'
cp_ bad-path; ap bad-path/skills/work/SKILL.md 'Keep notes in `.vloop/scratch/notes.md`.'
cp_ bad-fence-denied; ap bad-fence-denied/skills/work/SKILL.md 'Then run `vloop task verify T1 true --reason x`.'
cp_ bad-fence-not-allowed; ap bad-fence-not-allowed/skills/work/SKILL.md 'Then run `vloop config list`.'
cp_ bad-frontmatter-name; ap bad-frontmatter-name/skills/review/SKILL.md '---' 'name: reviewer' 'description: Judge one task.' '---' '# Review'
cp_ bad-frontmatter-field; ap bad-frontmatter-field/skills/plan/SKILL.md '---' 'name: plan' '---' '# Plan'
cp_ bad-eval-no-graders; ap bad-eval-no-graders/evals/case-b/prompt.md '---' 'max_turns: 5' 'allowed_tools: [Read]' '---' '/vloop:work T1'
cp_ bad-eval-max-turns; ap bad-eval-max-turns/evals/case-c/prompt.md '---' 'allowed_tools: [Read]' '---' '/vloop:work T1'; ap bad-eval-max-turns/evals/case-c/graders/g.md '---' 'type: llm' 'weight: 1' '---' x
cp_ bad-eval-weight; ap bad-eval-weight/evals/case-d/prompt.md '---' 'max_turns: 5' 'allowed_tools: [Read]' '---' '/vloop:work T1'; ap bad-eval-weight/evals/case-d/graders/g.md '---' 'type: llm' '---' x
cp_ operate-exempt; ap operate-exempt/skills/operate/SKILL.md '---' 'name: operate' 'description: The operator playbook.' '---' 'Resolve a dispute with `vloop task verify T1 true --reason x`, then `vloop run`, and record with `vloop defect add`.'
cp_ bad-operate-command; ap bad-operate-command/skills/operate/SKILL.md '---' 'name: operate' 'description: The operator playbook.' '---' 'Run `vloop task frobnicate T1`.'
cd ../../../.. && go test -count=1 -run 'TestPluginSkills|TestSkillChecksRejectFixtures' -v ./internal/cli 2>&1 | grep -v "^=== " | head -50

result:
T1 is done. I ran its verify command and it printed `GATE OK`. I wrote the proposal to `.loop/tmp/proposal.json`.

- **Checks:** `internal/cli/skills_test.go` has `TestPluginSkills`. It covers frontmatter, command tree, schemas, paths, skills against the embedded fence, and eval format. It reads `SKILLCHECK_PLUGIN_DIR`, or `../../plugin` when that is unset or empty. It passes vacuously on the real plugin, since there are no skills yet.
- **Fixtures:** `TestSkillChecksRejectFixtures` runs 15 committed fixture plugins under `internal/cli/testdata/skillcheck/`. One is well-formed and is accepted, and each defect fixture is rejected with a message naming its defect.
- **Domain model:** The "On disk" block in `docs/domain/domain-model.md` gains `.vloop/state/plan.md`, `.vloop/tmp/proposal.json`, `.vloop/tmp/verdict.json`, `.vloop/tmp/plugin/<version>/` and `.vloop/tmp/fence/<version>/settings.json`. I added lines only and changed no existing ones.
- **Gotcha:** `task` and `config` are runnable commands that take no arguments, so my first command-tree check missed `vloop task frobnicate`. A word is now unknown when its parent has subcommands and the parent's `Args` validator rejects it.
- **Name clash:** I named the checker `checkSkillPlugin` because `checkPlugin` already exists in `version.go`.
